title: 2026 SAF market, certificate and assurance QA controls

sources.title: RTFO and SAF Mandate recognised verifiers

facts.source_fact: The UK SAF Mandate has been in force since 1 January 2025.
facts.expected_handling: Attach mandate commencement date to compliance records.

facts.source_fact: The SAF Mandate is designed to support greenhouse-gas savings from aviation fuel use.
facts.expected_handling: Keep policy objective distinct from measured supplier performance.

facts.source_fact: The mandate sets an increasing legal requirement for SAF supply over time.
facts.expected_handling: Version obligation percentages by year.

facts.source_fact: SAF certificates are issued under rules linked to greenhouse-gas reduction and sustainability requirements.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer certificate eligibility without the applicable carbon and sustainability evidence.

facts.source_fact: The main SAF obligation applies from the 2025 obligation period.
facts.expected_handling: Keep obligation-year identity with supplier records.

facts.source_fact: A power-to-liquid sub-obligation begins from 2028 under the published framework.
facts.expected_handling: Treat the PtL rule as future until its applicable obligation year.

facts.source_fact: A HEFA cap applies from 2027 under the mandate framework.
facts.expected_handling: Apply HEFA limits only to the appropriate obligation year.

facts.source_fact: The permitted HEFA proportion falls over the published trajectory toward 2040.
facts.expected_handling: Version HEFA-cap policy by year.

facts.source_fact: A falling HEFA percentage does not necessarily imply falling absolute HEFA volume as the overall mandate grows.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer volume direction from percentage caps alone.

facts.source_fact: The framework is designed to support advanced SAF pathways beyond HEFA.
facts.expected_handling: Keep pathway identity in market and certificate analysis.

facts.source_fact: Suppliers applying for certificates must appoint a recognised independent verifier for required data assurance.
facts.expected_handling: Require recognised-verifier identity with assurance evidence.

facts.source_fact: Recognised verifiers provide limited assurance over carbon and sustainability information for certificate-related requirements.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve assurance level rather than describing it as reasonable assurance.

facts.source_fact: Relevant fuel-supply data must be independently verified before certificates are awarded.
facts.expected_handling: Block certificate-ready status where required verification is absent.

facts.source_fact: SAF Mandate fuel quantities require reasonable assurance from a recognised verifier under the published assurance framework.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the different assurance level for quantity data.

facts.source_fact: The fuel supplier is responsible for appointing the independent verifier.
facts.expected_handling: Bind verifier appointment to the obligated supplier.

facts.source_fact: The current recognised-verifier period shown by DfT runs through 31 December 2027.
facts.expected_handling: Check verifier validity for the assurance period.

facts.source_fact: Aardvark Certification, Normec Verifavia and TUV SUD were added to the recognised-verifier list on 17 June 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Use verifier-list vintage when checking recognition.

facts.source_fact: Third-party assurance guidance covers verification planning and risk assessment.
facts.expected_handling: Require assurance planning provenance for verified data.

facts.source_fact: The assurance framework covers assurance strategy, reporting and assurance statements.
facts.expected_handling: Keep assurance statement and strategy evidence linked.

facts.source_fact: The assurance framework also covers recognition of voluntary schemes and other national systems.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve scheme-recognition status separately from supplier assurance.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve mandate and assurance facts without broadening scope.
Attach supplier, fuel pathway, obligation year and certificate boundary.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents mixing mandate obligations and pathways.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach obligation year, verifier-list date and recognition validity.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents use of stale mandate or verifier status.

guard_patterns.handling: Carry verifier, assurance level, statement and certificate-method provenance.
Do not convert SAF market/certificate evidence into parcel-level measured emissions.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
